visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair, wearing a wide-brimmed conical straw hat and large black sunglasses, speaks directly into a handheld camera. She is wearing a green jacket over a red strap. The background shows a blurry indoor market setting with hanging woven baskets. (2) The scene shifts to a street view in Da Nang. The woman, still in her straw hat and sunglasses, walks across a busy street with another woman. Red lanterns hang from arches in the foreground. Vehicles and storefronts with red and white signs are visible in the background. (3) The camera pans to a large, ornate pink cathedral with white trim and a tall spire. People are walking around the paved courtyard in front of the building. The sky is overcast and grey. (4) The focus shifts to a religious grotto carved into a rock wall. A small blue and white statue of the Virgin Mary is nestled in a niche labeled 'AVE MARIA.' Pink orchids and green plants surround the statue. (5) A close-up shows a small pond with colorful koi fish swimming among lily pads and rocks. A miniature waterfall trickles down. Nearby, a glass display case holds a religious item. (6) The final phase shows people gathering around the grotto area. Red incense sticks are burning in a large stone vessel, sending thin plumes of white smoke into the air toward the Virgin Mary statue.
